results.rationale: Consistency: the pale background remains, but the third baguette that should have stayed is also removed. Instruction: all three baguettes disappear rather than exactly two, so the requested removal is overapplied. Quality: the resulting plain surface has coherent soft texture and no visible cutout seams or remnants.

Consistency: the trouser silhouette, waistband, button, belt loops, pleats, pockets, hems and white background remain intact. Instruction: the cream fabric becomes blue across both legs and waistband. Quality: the blue fabric has natural shading and folds with clean edges and no visible artifacts.
